types.name: NUMBER
types.description: Variable-precision fixed/floating-point number. p = total digits (1-38), s = digits after the decimal point.

types.name: FLOAT
types.description: ANSI floating-point number stored as a NUMBER subtype.

types.name: VARCHAR2
types.description: Variable-length character string, max 4000 bytes (32767 with extended data types).

types.name: CHAR
types.description: Fixed-length character string, blank-padded, max 2000 bytes.

types.name: CLOB
types.description: Character large object, up to 4GB of character data.

types.name: DATE
types.description: Date and time to the second (year 4712 BC to 9999 AD).

types.name: TIMESTAMP
types.description: Date and time with fractional seconds precision p (0-9).

types.name: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
types.description: Timestamp including a time zone offset.

types.name: INTERVAL DAY TO SECOND
types.description: Stores a duration in days, hours, minutes, and seconds.

types.name: RAW
types.description: Variable-length raw binary data, max 2000 bytes.

types.name: BOOLEAN
types.description: PL/SQL boolean type; not usable directly as a table column type prior to 23c.
types.notes: Use NUMBER(1) or CHAR(1) as a boolean column workaround on older versions.

types.name: ROWID
types.description: Base64-encoded physical row address, unique within a database.
